name: Kodo Hide Bag
summary: Veren Tallstrider teaches Thunder Bluff's apprentice leatherworkers a craft drawn from the plains. He asks for cured light leather and sturdy thread.

sections.title: A Lesson on the Mesa
sections.body: Veren Tallstrider teaches leatherworking on Thunder Bluff's crafting rises. He follows the nomadic way of wasting nothing from the hunt. Bring cured light leather and sturdy thread, and he will teach you. With these basic materials, apprentices show they can make goods to carry survival gear across Kalimdor's rugged expanses.

sections.title: Spirit of the Kodo
sections.body: To the tauren, the kodo is a sign of endurance, strength, and steady resolve. Its thick hide guards against brambles, biting wind, and beast claws. Making bags and garments from kodo hide is useful work, and it honors the animal that has fed and carried the Shu'halo across Mulgore's plains for generations.

faq.q: Who offers the Kodo Hide Bag quest?
aliases: where to get kodo hide bag quest
faq.answer: Veren Tallstrider, a tauren leatherworking trainer and merchant in Thunder Bluff, offers the training.

faq.q: Who is eligible to undertake this task?
faq.answer: Leatherworkers with at least apprentice skill level ten can receive this training from Veren Tallstrider.

faq.q: What materials does Veren Tallstrider require?
faq.answer: Veren Tallstrider asks for four pieces of Light Leather and four spools of Coarse Thread to replenish his trade supplies before he shares his pattern.

faq.q: Why is kodo hide considered significant to tauren crafters?
faq.answer: Kodos embody resilience and physical might, qualities the tauren cherish. Gear made from their hides honors the creature's spirit and equips travelers crossing the plains.

faq.q: What does Veren Tallstrider teach upon completion?
faq.answer: After receiving the supplies, Veren teaches the crafter to stitch a Kodo Hide Bag.

faq.q: Where can the necessary materials be acquired?
faq.answer: You can skin low-level beasts throughout Mulgore and nearby lands for Light Leather. Trade and tailoring vendors sell Coarse Thread.

angles.text: As Shu'halo, you honor the Earth Mother's bounty and preserve ancestral ways by learning to craft reliable gear from the mighty kodo.
As a member of the Horde, you rely on Thunder Bluff's craftsmen for goods that keep hunters, scouts, and warriors equipped across central Kalimdor.
